rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person or event that turns out fortunately.

example.english: I was lucky to catch the last train.
example.jyutping: hou2 coi2 ngo5 gon2 dak1 cit3 mei5 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this for the direct sense of being fortunate, especially in more formal wording or compounds.

example.english: I feel very lucky to be able to take part in this project.
example.traditional: 能夠參與呢項計劃，我感到非常幸運。
example.jyutping: nang4 gau3 caam1 jyu4 ni1 hong6 gai3 waak6 ngo5 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 hang6 wan6

rows.note: Use this when something is regarded as auspicious or as bringing good fortune, rather than merely having a fortunate outcome.

example.english: Getting customers on the very first day is really lucky.
example.traditional: 開張第一日就有客人上門，真係好吉利。
example.jyutping: hoi1 zoeng1 dai6 jat1 jat6 zau6 jau5 haak3 jan4 soeng5 mun4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gat1 lei6
